title: Jissen Mahjong
overview:
King of Game - Mahjong. Its deep strategy and fun, and an excitement you cannot escape, are here!!

Sit down at the table for a game of Japanese mahjong against computer opponents. Switch between viewpoints, including an angled view across the table, for a more lifelike game, while quick-thinking opponents keep play moving at a comfortable pace.

- 1 player
- Memory backup support

KING OF GAME――麻雀。その奥深き戦略と楽しさ、そして逃れがたき興奮がここにある!!
